BILL NUMBER:  S701

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the real property tax law, in relation to subjecting
certain state land in Orange county to real property taxation


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
Legislation that would compensate all municipalities in New York State
for state owed land not on the local tax rolls that are part of the
Palisades Park System.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
All lands in the counties of Rockland and Sullivan, and in the towns
of Monroe, Warwick, Wallkill, Cornwall, Highlands, Tuxedo and
Woodbury, Orange County, and in the towns of Gardiner, Rochester,
Shawangunk, Warwarsing, Ulster County, acquired for a public use by
the commissioners of the Palisades Interstate Park, exclusive of the
improvements erected thereon by the state.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Some towns receive compensation while others do not.  The intent of
this legislation is to bring about equity.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
2003-2004: A.3880, held for consideration in real property taxation.
2001-2002: A.6028, not considered.
S.5311 of 2005-2006.
S.530 of 2007-2008

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately and shall apply to assessment
rolls prepared on the basis of taxable status dates occurring on or
after the date on which this act shall have become a law.

summary: Subjects lands in the town of Wallkill, Orange County, which are acquired for a public use by the commissioners of the Palisades Interstate park, exclusive of improvements thereon erected by the state, to real property taxation.
title: Subjects certain land in the town of Wallkill, Orange county, to real property taxation
